versions.description: The ACME operator of Norca (norca-acme of norca-platform) as one release: the ACL policy bound to its job and the job, which is the controller of the norca.io/CertificateIssuer objects that sign through an ACME certificate authority such as Let's Encrypt. It fulfils the certificate orders of the servers, answers the HTTP-01 challenge behind the edge router and proves names in DNS zones through norca-provider.

It fulfils the certificate orders of the servers, answers the HTTP-01 challenge behind the edge router and proves names in DNS zones through norca-provider.
